Restaurant tools seen (Karma, Caspeco, Purspot) have online ordering but no price on their sites; logged as not_relevant because SE already has 3 food-truck tools, not because they lack ordering. Zettle (becoming PayPal Point of Sale) and SumUp have no food online ordering on their Swedish sites. StreetKäk's domain no longer resolves; MenYou (App Store only, no own site found) skipped.
